title: Acidlands
body:
Description

The Acidlands is a secondary location on the Oaklands map, off the coast of Finlay. It is characterized by its green hues and its expansive acidic waters. It is accessible behind an explodable wall, requiring 3 Small Bombs (or 1 TNT barrel) to break through.

  • The Acidlands has two entrances:
  1. The Finlay entrance is located between Lighthouse and Flowering Meadows.
  2. The Mike's Mines entrance is located to the right of the Mikes Mines Farlands entry and then downhill right again at the T intersection.

It is also possible to reach the Acidlands without spending explosives once the player has obtained a Refined Scooba Tank.

The Acidlands are difficult to traverse using a car, so some tips for traversing the Acidlands are:

  • Some areas may be easier to traverse on foot, it may be useful to have a grabber to move ores back.
  • Having more than one trailer is risky; one trailer may fall into a hole and pull the rest of your vehicle with it, or trailers could simply get stuck in holes.
  • The Sellner Explorer is the most useful vehicle for this area, as it is relatively good at traversing narrow spaces, while having about as much cargo space as a single trailer.
  • Don’t be afraid to take multiple trips to avoid losing all of your ores.

Lumberwork

The Acidlands are the spawn locations for Willow trees and Windswept Pine trees. Willow wood offers middling profits when sold at the Resource Hub. However, their unique green coloration can be used in forest-like and mystical builds, as well as in making foliage.

Flora and Fauna

Near the pedestal where the Uncertain Pickaxe can be obtained, there are several Corpse Flowers on the ground. When pressed in a Press Machine, it sells for $1,000 coins, making it a profitable flower for early game players. While there are no animals in the game, there are multiple references to Greeb Goblins made.

Mining

Two types of stone node spawns in this location - Gravel, and Grimestone, which spawns in large, green stalagmite-like structures. While not unique to this area or stone type, two rare ores that have a higher chance of spawning in this location are:

  • Greeb in Marble or Grimestone nodes.
  • Uranium in Limestone or Grimestone nodes. Mainly spawns in the Acid Smog.
  • Inkstone in Limestone, Lightslate, Grimestone and more nodes.

Note that other more common ores, like Inkstone and Iron, can still spawn in Grimestone as well. Due to the large average size of Grimestone pieces, players can retrieve the largest possible size of Uranium at the Acidlands.

Secret Quests

The Acidlands also contains the main Pedestal for both the Uncertain Pickaxe and Adurite Key quests. The entrance to the pedestal is slightly obfuscated - it is accessible by walking/driving across a stone bridge similar to the stone spires.
